subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require live current-main proof before accepting https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307 as the fix for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection strongly supports the candidate fix, but the reported failure is a runtime session/provider handoff and the open PR currently has unit-level proof only.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted gateway or Docker output showing a secondary-agent heartbeat under global scope uses that agent's workspace/session before merge and close.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Maintainers can review and merge the open candidate PR on source and unit-test evidence if they intentionally accept the unproven runtime handoff risk.

options.title: Hold for broader routing review
options.body: Pause the candidate PR and fold this into a larger global-session and dmScope routing review if maintainers want to revisit the session contract first.

recommendation.title: Require live proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted gateway or Docker output showing a secondary-agent heartbeat under global scope uses that agent's workspace/session before merge and close.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent source ownership point to this person as the strongest routing/history contact for the affected heartbeat and agent-scope code.
